worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.summary: Step in and bring a hand chop straight down: it hurts the target and shatters the whole patch of Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil around where the blade lands. The fastest and cheapest of the family.
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.use.0: A quick chop at close range
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.use.1: Shred a barrier the moment it goes up
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.use.2: The cheapest way to open a warded target
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.description: The chop deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block half-width; the target's Defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
Reach %1$s blocks; Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil within %2$s blocks of the landing point shatter together, no prior hit on the body required.
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.wide.on: Wide mode: a 1.5x chop face, a 1.25x shatter radius and longer reach catch more of the corridor; the cost is 0.9x single-hit power, +2 ticks of preparation and +8 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.wide.off: Focused mode: a more precise, harder single-target chop at 1.06x power with quicker preparation and cooldown; the shatter radius and chop face stay at their base.
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.growth.0: From level %1$s the chop rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.brickbreak.growth.1: From level %1$s the chop rises to %2$s and the shatter radius to %3$s.
On: a wider chop face and shatter radius that catch more of the corridor, at lower single-hit power and longer preparation and cooldown. Off: a focused, harder single-target chop.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of chopping. Larger values open from further out.
On: prefer a target carrying Reflect, Light Screen or Aurora Veil and break the barrier first. Off: rank by threat and distance only.
